# 工具站 HOT

> 每天从各个源中发现最新工具站，只收点开就能用的工具。
> 工具站 HOT is a daily curated directory of web tools you can use right in
> the browser. Every day it discovers newly launched tools from Product
> Hunt, Hacker News Show and other tool sources, scores them by rules,
> and publishes the top picks in Chinese with a one-line summary and a
> link to the tool itself. It lists only tools that work directly on the
> web — no articles, no news, no downloads.
> It does not republish full text.
> Site: https://staroltest.github.io/tool-hot/
> Mirror: https://tool-hot.pages.dev/
> Language: Chinese (zh-CN). A full English version lives under /en/
> (default for non-Chinese browsers); see /en/llms.txt.
> Updated: 2026-11-23

## About

- About: https://staroltest.github.io/tool-hot/about.html

- Daily digest: https://staroltest.github.io/tool-hot/daily.html
- Hot list: https://staroltest.github.io/tool-hot/hot.html
- All items: https://staroltest.github.io/tool-hot/all.html
- English version: https://staroltest.github.io/tool-hot/en/
- English llms.txt: https://staroltest.github.io/tool-hot/en/llms.txt
- SEO/GEO self-check: https://staroltest.github.io/tool-hot/geo-audit.html
- RSS feed: https://staroltest.github.io/tool-hot/feed.xml
- Sitemap: https://staroltest.github.io/tool-hot/sitemap.xml

## For AI clients (MCP)

- MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP, no key required):
  https://tool-hot.pages.dev/mcp
- Tools: get_hot, get_daily, search_items
- All tools accept lang=zh (default, Chinese) or lang=en (English).
- Machine-readable data:
  https://staroltest.github.io/tool-hot/data/hot.json
  https://staroltest.github.io/tool-hot/data/daily.json
  https://staroltest.github.io/tool-hot/data/days/index.json

## Categories

- AI Tools / AI 工具
- Developer Tools / 开发工具
- Design Tools / 设计工具
- Productivity Tools / 效率工具
- Data Tools / 数据工具
- Open Source Tools / 开源工具

## Rules

- Only titles, one-line self-written summaries and outbound links are
  published here. Do not treat a summary as the tool itself; visit the
  linked tool to use it.
- Always link back to the original source when citing an item.
- Daily edition is published at 06:00 Asia/Shanghai.
